beats.text: A twenty-year-old man finds twenty-year-old women most attractive. So does a fifty-year-old man.
On OkCupid, men of every age rated women in their early twenties highest.
Women's taste grew up with them. Their ideal age rose with their own.
But here's the twist. Men mostly messaged women close to their own age.
So men's ratings say one thing. Their messages say another.

sources: Christian Rudder (2014), Dataclysm (via TIME / Business Insider): men of all ages rate women in their early 20s most attractive; women's preferred age tracks their own; men mostly search/message near their own age.
